item.title: The Last Dry Seat

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.

item.tests: Turns two described characters and a simple story into one assembled 15-second film with a readable setup, kind gesture and resolution.

answer_sheet.Characters: A young adult woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; an older adult man with a white beard and blue coat.
answer_sheet.Story and setting: A wet park bench; the woman finds it wet, the man offers his folded newspaper as a dry seat, then they sit together and smile.
answer_sheet.Length and format: One 15-second widescreen 16:9 video, with three scenes.
answer_sheet.Sound, dialogue and text: Silent, with no dialogue, captions or titles.

must_haves: One playable 15-second widescreen film contains three sequential scenes, not separate clip deliverables.
The woman has a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; the man has a white beard and blue coat.
The opening visibly establishes that the park bench is wet.
The man offers a folded newspaper as a dry place to sit, and the ending shows both characters seated together and smiling.
The film has a live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A silent 15-second live-action short film in three sequential scenes, widescreen 16:9. Photorealistic naturalistic cinematography, soft overcast daylight in a quiet park just after rain, wet greenery, muted natural colors punctuated by a yellow raincoat. Sweet, observant, understated human kindness, never sentimental or cheesy. Consistent characters throughout: an adult young woman in her late twenties with a curly black bob and a yellow raincoat; an older adult man with a white beard and a blue coat. Same park bench and location throughout. Scene 1, seconds 0-5: medium wide establishing shot. The woman approaches an empty rain-wet wooden park bench, notices beads of water on its seat, lightly touches the wet surface and pauses, wanting to sit. Scene 2, seconds 5-10: cut to a natural medium two-shot. The older man standing beside the bench notices her hesitation and gently offers her his folded newspaper, indicating she can sit on it. She accepts with a small grateful smile, lays the folded newspaper flat on the wet seat. Make the newspaper handoff clear and physically believable. Scene 3, seconds 10-15: cut to a quiet wide two-shot. She sits on the newspaper, he sits beside her leaving comfortable space. They exchange small genuine smiles, then look peacefully out at the park. Hold the final moment. Modest everyday gestures, relaxed expressions, no exaggerated acting, no romance, no big emotional payoff. Simple clean cuts between three scenes, stable camera, realistic hands and movement. Entirely silent: no audio, no music, no dialogue, no sound effects. No captions, titles, logos or text overlays.
